description: Failure classification rules. First match wins; order = precedence (Environment > Test Data > Script > Defect). pattern is a JS regex source, flags its flags.

rules.pattern: browserType\.launch|Executable doesn't exist|webServer|ENOSPC|out of memory|ENOMEM|EADDRINUSE|Target (page, context or )?browser has been closed
rules.reason: Runner/infrastructure problem (browser, web server, disk, memory, port)
500 from server; may be a real defect, check server log
Duplicate/constraint conflict: data left over from earlier run or not unique
Expected data is missing: seed/fixture not loaded or wrong

rules.pattern: waiting for (locator|getBy\w+|selector)|strict mode violation|element\(s\) not found|intercepts pointer events|element is not (visible|stable|enabled|attached)|Locator:\s
rules.reason: Locator not found/ambiguous/not actionable: script or selector problem

rules.pattern: \b(TypeError|ReferenceError|SyntaxError)\b|is not a function|Cannot read propert|is not defined|is undefined
Test timeout of \d+ms exceeded|Timeout \d+ms exceeded|page\.waitFor\w*: Timeout
rules.reason: Test timed out with no sign of an environment problem: wait/sync problem in script
Assertion on business behavior failed while script and environment look healthy
